about.label: Royal Bank of Canada
about.summary: Canadian multinational financial services company and the largest bank in Canada by market capitalization.
about.summary_cs: Největší kanadská banka podle tržní hodnoty.

about.label: Toronto-Dominion Bank
about.summary: Canadian multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Toronto, Ontario.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská banka se sídlem v Torontu, která působí i ve velké části USA.

about.label: Shopify
about.summary: Canadian multinational e-commerce company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, that operates a cloud e-commerce management platform for retail point-of-sale systems. Major customers include Tesla, LVMH, Nestlé, PepsiCo, AB InBev, Kraft Heinz, Lindt, Whole Foods Market, Red Bull, and Hyatt.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská firma, jejíž platforma umožňuje obchodníkům založit a provozovat e-shop i prodej na pokladně.

about.label: Bank of Montreal
about.summary: Canadian multinational investment bank and financial services company.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská nadnárodní banka a poskytovatel finančních služeb.

about.label: Scotiabank
about.summary: Canadian multinational banking and financial services company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská banka se sídlem v Torontu, která působí hlavně v Americe.

about.label: Enbridge
about.summary: Canadian pipeline and energy company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Enbridge owns and operates pipelines throughout Canada and the United States, transporting crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids, and also generates renewable energy.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská energetická firma, která provozuje ropovody a plynovody v Kanadě a USA a vyrábí i obnovitelnou energii.

about.label: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce
about.summary: Canadian multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at CIBC Square in Toronto's Financial District.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská nadnárodní banka se sídlem v Torontu.

about.label: Canadian Natural Resources
about.summary: Senior Canadian oil and natural gas company that operates primarily in the Western Canadian provinces of British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba, with offshore operations in the United Kingdom sector of the North Sea, and offshore Côte d'Ivoire and Gabon.
about.summary_cs: Velká kanadská ropná a plynárenská firma, která těží hlavně v západní Kanadě, v Severním moři a u pobřeží západní Afriky.

about.label: Agnico Eagle Mines
about.summary: Canadian gold producer with operations in Canada, Finland, Australia and Mexico and exploration and development activities extending to the United States.
about.summary_cs: Kanadský těžař zlata s doly v Kanadě, Finsku, Austrálii a Mexiku.

about.label: Suncor Energy
about.summary: Canadian integrated energy company based in Calgary, Alberta. It specializes in production of synthetic crude from oil sands.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská energetická firma, která těží ropu z ropných písků, rafinuje ji a provozuje čerpací stanice.

about.label: Barrick Mining Corporation
about.summary: Mining company that produces gold and copper.
about.summary_cs: Těžební firma, která těží zlato a měď.

about.label: TC Energy
about.summary: Canadian energy company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta and serving North America. The company's focus is fossil fuel pipelines, and it builds and operates energy infrastructure across Canada, the United States, and Mexico, with core business segments in Natural Gas Pipelines, Power Generation and Energy Storage.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská energetická firma, která staví a provozuje plynovody v Kanadě, USA a Mexiku.

about.label: Nutrien
about.summary: Canadian fertilizer company based in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. It is the largest producer of potash, second largest producer of nitrogen fertilizer in the world and generally the 2nd largest in fertilizers worldwide.
about.summary_cs: Kanadský výrobce hnojiv, největší producent draselných hnojiv na světě.

about.label: Teck Resources
about.summary: Diversified natural resources company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, that is engaged in mining and mineral development, including coal for the steelmaking industry, copper, zinc, and energy. Secondary products include lead, silver, gold, molybdenum, germanium, indium and cadmium.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská těžební firma, která těží hlavně měď a zinek.

about.label: Kinross Gold
about.summary: Canadian gold and silver mining company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská firma, která těží zlato a stříbro.

about.label: Pan American Silver
about.summary: Mining company based in Canada with operations in Latin America.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská firma, která těží stříbro a zlato v Latinské Americe.

about.label: First Quantum Minerals
about.summary: Canadian-based mining and metals company whose principal activities include mineral exploration, development, and mining.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská těžební firma, hlavně těžař mědi s doly v Zambii, Panamě a dalších zemích.

about.label: Alamos Gold
about.summary: Canadian multinational gold producer, headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
about.summary_cs: Kanadský nadnárodní těžař zlata se sídlem v Torontu.
